<?php

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $metadata = [];
    private int $maxConnections;
    private int $activeCount = 0;
    private int $reservedSlots = 0;
    
    public function __construct(int $maxConnections = 1024) {
        $this->maxConnections = $maxConnections;
    }
    
    public function getAvailableSlots(): int {
        return $this->maxConnections - $this->activeCount - $this->reservedSlots;
    }
    
    public function reserveSlots(int $count): bool {
        if ($count <= 0) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($this->getAvailableSlots() >= $count) {
            $this->reservedSlots += $count;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public function releaseReservation(int $count): void {
        if ($count <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        $this->reservedSlots = max(0, $this->reservedSlots - $count);
    }
    
    public function addConnection(string $connId, array $meta): bool {
        if ($this->activeCount >= $this->maxConnections) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->connections[$connId] = true;
        $this->metadata[$connId] = $meta;
        $this->activeCount++;
        return true;
    }
    
    public function removeConnection(string $connId): void {
        if (isset($this->connections[$connId])) {
            unset($this->connections[$connId]);
            unset($this->metadata[$connId]);
            $this->activeCount = max(0, $this->activeCount - 1);
        }
    }
    
    public function getActiveCount(): int {
        return $this->activeCount;
    }
    
    public function getReservedSlots(): int {
        return $this->reservedSlots;
    }
}

class ChatRoom {
    private string $roomId;
    private array $members = [];
    private int $maxMembers;
    
    public function __construct(string $roomId, int $maxMembers = 50) {
        $this->roomId = $roomId;
        $this->maxMembers = $maxMembers;
    }
    
    public function getRoomId(): string {
        return $this->roomId;
    }
    
    public function getMemberCount(): int {
        return count($this->members);
    }
    
    public function addMember(string $userId): bool {
        if (count($this->members) >= $this->maxMembers) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->members[$userId] = time();
        return true;
    }
    
    public function removeMember(string $userId): void {
        unset($this->members[$userId]);
    }
    
    public function hasMember(string $userId): bool {
        return isset($this->members[$userId]);
    }
}

class ChatServer {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private array $rooms = [];
    private array $userRooms = [];
    private array $pendingTransfers = [];
    
    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }
    
    public function createRoom(string $roomId, int $maxMembers = 50): bool {
        if (isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->rooms[$roomId] = new ChatRoom($roomId, $maxMembers);
        return true;
    }
    
    public function handleConnect(string $userId, string $roomId): array {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$roomId])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Room not found'];
        }
        
        $connId = $this->generateConnId($userId, $roomId);
        
        if (!$this->pool->addConnection($connId, ['user' => $userId, 'room' => $roomId])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Connection pool full'];
        }
        
        if (!$this->rooms[$roomId]->addMember($userId)) {
            $this->pool->removeConnection($connId);
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Room full'];
        }
        
        $this->userRooms[$userId] = $roomId;
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'connId' => $connId];
    }
    
    public function handleDisconnect(string $userId): array {
        if (!isset($this->userRooms[$userId])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'User not connected'];
        }
        
        $roomId = $this->userRooms[$userId];
        $connId = $this->generateConnId($userId, $roomId);
        
        $this->rooms[$roomId]->removeMember($userId);
        $this->pool->removeConnection($connId);
        unset($this->userRooms[$userId]);
        
        return ['status' => 'ok'];
    }
    
    /**
     * Initiates a batch transfer of users between rooms.
     * Reserves connection slots for the transfer to prevent race conditions.
     */
    public function initiateBatchTransfer(string $fromRoom, string $toRoom, array $userIds): array {
        if (!isset($this->rooms[$fromRoom]) || !isset($this->rooms[$toRoom])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Invalid room'];
        }
        
        $validUsers = array_filter($userIds, function($uid) use ($fromRoom) {
            return $this->rooms[$fromRoom]->hasMember($uid);
        });
        
        $transferCount = count($validUsers);
        if ($transferCount === 0) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'No valid users to transfer'];
        }
        
        // Reserve slots in the pool for the new connections
        if (!$this->pool->reserveSlots($transferCount)) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Insufficient pool capacity'];
        }
        
        $transferId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->pendingTransfers[$transferId] = [
            'from' => $fromRoom,
            'to' => $toRoom,
            'users' => array_values($validUsers),
            'reserved' => $transferCount,
            'completed' => 0,
            'failed' => 0
        ];
        
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'transferId' => $transferId, 'count' => $transferCount];
    }
    
    /**
     * Processes the next user in a pending batch transfer.
     * Called repeatedly until all users are transferred.
     */
    public function processTransferStep(string $transferId): array {
        if (!isset($this->pendingTransfers[$transferId])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Transfer not found'];
        }
        
        $transfer = &$this->pendingTransfers[$transferId];
        $idx = $transfer['completed'] + $transfer['failed'];
        
        if ($idx >= count($transfer['users'])) {
            // Transfer complete, release unused reservations
            $unusedSlots = $transfer['reserved'] - $transfer['completed'];
            $this->pool->releaseReservation($unusedSlots);
            unset($this->pendingTransfers[$transferId]);
            return ['status' => 'complete'];
        }
        
        $userId = $transfer['users'][$idx];
        $fromRoom = $transfer['from'];
        $toRoom = $transfer['to'];
        
        // Remove from old room and connection
        $oldConnId = $this->generateConnId($userId, $fromRoom);
        $this->rooms[$fromRoom]->removeMember($userId);
        $this->pool->removeConnection($oldConnId);
        
        // Add to new room
        $newConnId = $this->generateConnId($userId, $toRoom);
        if ($this->rooms[$toRoom]->addMember($userId)) {
            $this->pool->addConnection($newConnId, ['user' => $userId, 'room' => $toRoom]);
            $this->userRooms[$userId] = $toRoom;
            $transfer['completed']++;
        } else {
            $transfer['failed']++;
        }
        
        return ['status' => 'in_progress', 'processed' => $idx + 1];
    }
    
    /**
     * Cancels a pending transfer and releases only the unused reservations.
     * Users already transferred remain in their new room.
     */
    public function cancelTransfer(string $transferId): array {
        if (!isset($this->pendingTransfers[$transferId])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'msg' => 'Transfer not found'];
        }
        
        $transfer = $this->pendingTransfers[$transferId];
        
        // Only release reservations that haven't been consumed by completed transfers
        $remainingReservations = $transfer['reserved'] - $transfer['completed'];
        $this->pool->releaseReservation($remainingReservations);
        unset($this->pendingTransfers[$transferId]);
        
        return ['status' => 'cancelled'];
    }
    
    public function getPoolStatus(): array {
        return [
            'active' => $this->pool->getActiveCount(),
            'reserved' => $this->pool->getReservedSlots(),
            'available' => $this->pool->getAvailableSlots()
        ];
    }
    
    private function generateConnId(string $userId, string $roomId): string {
        return hash('sha256', $userId . ':' . $roomId);
    }
}

// Server initialization and request handling
$pool = new ConnectionPool(1024);
$server = new ChatServer($pool);
$server->createRoom('general', 100);
$server->createRoom('vip', 20);

// Example usage demonstrating the transfer flow
$server->handleConnect('user1', 'general');
$server->handleConnect('user2', 'general');
$server->handleConnect('user3', 'general');

$result = $server->initiateBatchTransfer('general', 'vip', ['user1', 'user2', 'user3']);
if ($result['status'] === 'ok') {
    // Process one step
    $server->processTransferStep($result['transferId']);
    // Then cancel the rest
    $server->cancelTransfer($result['transferId']);
}

echo json_encode($server->getPoolStatus());
